Concise description: Deploy SANDF to deal with gang violence and illegal mining
Exact quotes: I have directed the Minister of Police and the SANDF to develop a tactical plan where our security forces should be deployed within the next few days in the Western Cape and Gauteng to deal with gang violence and illegal mining.
Reasoning: Organised crime is now the most immediate threat to our democracy and economic development.

Concise description: Recruit 5500 additional police officers
Exact quotes: We are putting more boots on the ground through the recruitment this year of 5 500 additional police officers
Reasoning: To strengthen the fight against crime and gang violence.

Concise description: Establish National Illicit Economy Disruption Programme
Exact quotes: We are establishing a National Illicit Economy Disruption Programme that brings together key state agencies and other stakeholders including the private sector.
Reasoning: To target high-risk sectors like tobacco fuel alcohol and other counterfeit products.

Concise description: Introduce Whistle-Blower Protection Bill
Exact quotes: The Whistle-Blower Protection Bill will be introduced in Parliament.
Reasoning: To protect those who speak out against corruption from being victimised and targeted.

Concise description: Finalise new Public Procurement Act regulations
Exact quotes: finalisation of new Public Procurement Act regulations by mid-2026.
Reasoning: To end corruption in the procurement system where most incidents originate.

Concise description: Public funding for water and sanitation infrastructure
Exact quotes: We have committed more than R156 billion in public funding for water and sanitation infrastructure over the next three years.
Reasoning: To ensure water security in the long term through building new dams and upgrading infrastructure.

Concise description: Establish National Water Crisis Committee
Exact quotes: we will now elevate our response to the water crisis to a National Water Crisis Committee which I will chair.
Reasoning: To enable a focused national response and single coordinating body for water challenges.

Concise description: Lay charges against Municipal Managers for water neglect
Exact quotes: We will now move to lay charges against Municipal Managers in their personal capacity for violating the National Water Act of 1998.
Reasoning: To hold to account those who neglect their responsibility of supplying water to our people.

Concise description: Incentive for metros to reform water and electricity services
Exact quotes: we have introduced a new R54 billion incentive for metros to reform their water sanitation and electricity services.
Reasoning: To ensure that revenue from water usage is put straight back into fixing pipes and infrastructure.

Concise description: Finalise revised White Paper on Local Government
Exact quotes: in the coming months finalise a revised White Paper on Local Government.
Reasoning: To provide solutions for the functioning of an effective local government system that is currently too complex.

Concise description: Public investment to build and maintain infrastructure
Exact quotes: Government has committed more than R1 trillion in public investment over three years to build and maintain infrastructure.
Reasoning: Infrastructure is an investment in jobs productivity and growth.

Concise description: Establish specialised courts for commercial matters
Exact quotes: we will establish specialised courts for commercial matters with dedicated judges and dedicated court rolls
Reasoning: To ensure faster outcomes in matters that have a bearing on the economy and prevent delays.

Concise description: Establish professional State Property Company
Exact quotes: This year, we will begin work to establish a professional State Property Company
Reasoning: To transform 88 000 buildings and five million hectares of land into engines of growth.

Concise description: Renewable energy supply target
Exact quotes: By 2030 more than 40% of our energy supply will come from cheap clean and renewable energy sources.
Reasoning: To ensure long-term energy security and drive down costs.

Concise description: Eradicate load reduction
Exact quotes: objective of eradicating load reduction by next year.
Reasoning: To address transformer overloading and equipment failure.

Concise description: Initiate PPPs in port terminals and rail corridors
Exact quotes: Later this year we will initiate major public-private partnerships in our port terminals and rail corridors
Reasoning: To mobilise private investment and expertise while preserving public ownership.

Concise description: Request For Proposals for high-speed rail
Exact quotes: We are preparing to send out a Request For Proposals which will introduce a new era of long-distance rail travel
Reasoning: To modernise the transport system and improve connectivity.

Concise description: Vaccination of national cattle herd
Exact quotes: We have decided to vaccinate the national herd of 14 million cattle. This requires 28 million vaccines over the next 12 months.
Reasoning: To deal with one of the worst outbreaks of foot-and-mouth disease.

Concise description: Extend Electronic Travel Authorisation to more countries
Exact quotes: In the coming year we will extend the Electronic Travel Authorisation System to all countries that require a visa
Reasoning: To promote tourism and process applications digitally within 24 hours.

Concise description: Tax deduction for investment in new energy vehicles
Exact quotes: From March this year we will introduce a 150% tax deduction for investment in new energy vehicles
Reasoning: To support green growth and local production of batteries.

Concise description: Raise new investments target
Exact quotes: We have now set ourselves a target of raising R2 trillion in new investments over the next five years.
Reasoning: To build a more inclusive economy and drive sustained growth.

Concise description: Host sixth South Africa Investment Conference
Exact quotes: hosting the sixth South Africa Investment Conference on 31 March 2026.
Reasoning: To attract further investment into the country.

Concise description: Funding for small and medium enterprises
Exact quotes: This year we will provide more than R2.5 billion in funding to over 180 000 small and medium enterprises
Reasoning: To back those who create opportunity and help them grow.

Concise description: Increase employment equity targets for persons with disabilities
Exact quotes: increase employment equity targets of persons with disabilities in the Public Service to 7% by 2030
Reasoning: To ensure that no one is left behind and correct past injustices.

Concise description: End child stunting
Exact quotes: embark on a mission to end child stunting by 2030
Reasoning: To tackle malnutrition which affects the ability of children to learn and grow.

Concise description: Redesign Social Relief of Distress Grant
Exact quotes: This year we will redesign the grant to more effectively support livelihoods
Reasoning: To improve the lives of the poorest and support productive activity.

Concise description: Phase 4 construction of District Six restoration
Exact quotes: With R500 million allocated to this work we are proceeding with Phase 4 of construction.
Reasoning: To redress the injustices of the past and build cohesive communities.

Concise description: Rollout of Lenacapavir for HIV prevention
Exact quotes: undertaking a massive rollout of Lenacapavir a six-monthly injection that has proven highly effective in preventing HIV transmission.
Reasoning: To prevent and ultimately eliminate HIV.

Concise description: Hire additional labour inspectors
Exact quotes: To tighten enforcement we will hire an additional 10 000 labour inspectors this year.
Reasoning: To crack down on violations of immigration and labour laws.

Concise description: Launch Digital ID
Exact quotes: This year the DHA will launch a Digital ID to enable safe and secure use of digital services
Reasoning: To harness digital transformation for inclusion and effective service delivery.

Concise description: Expand Smart ID and passport services in bank branches
Exact quotes: This year alone hundreds more bank branches will now offer Smart ID and passport services
Reasoning: To decrease queues and waiting times for citizens.
